spans.s: mounted, risen, ascended, AV. &c. &c.
lifted up, imposed on, laden (see -परिच्छद)
grown together, healed, R.; Suśr.
sprung up, grown, increased, developed, produced from (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
budded, blown, W.
large, great, MW.
high, noble (see -वंश)
diffused, spread about, widely known, current, notorious, famous, Kāv.; Sāh.

traditional, conventional, popular (opp. to यौगिक and said of words which have a meaning not directly connected with their etymology; esp. in pl. applied to names of warrior tribes, which also denote the country inhabited by them), Śiś.; Pāṇ., Sch. &c.
acquainted or conversant with (loc.), Gaṇit.
certain, ascertained, W.
obscure, MW.
a scar (also n. and f(आ). )
barley, L.
रूढि. See col. 2 and above.
रूढ—ग्रन्थि mfn. forming a knot, Uttarar.
रूढ—तृणाङ्कुर mfn. (a palace) on the roof of which young grass has sprouted, Ragh.
रूढ—परिच्छद mfn. laden with chattels, BhP.
रूढ—पर्याय mfn. (a ceremony) in which the regularly returning formulas are constantly increasing, Lāṭy.
रूढ—प्रणय mfn. one whose love or affection has grown strong, MW.
रूढ—मन्यु mfn. one whose passion has grown strong, BhP.
one who has taken root, Bcar.
रूढ—मूल-त्व n. having taken firm root, firmness (अ-र्˚), Mālav.
रूढ—योग mfn. one whose Yoga or devotion has increased, ib.
रूढ—यौवन mfn. one who has attained to youth or adolescence, ib.; Kathās. &c.
रूढ—राग-प्रवाल mfn. (the tree of love) in which the sprouts of affection have grown strong, Mālav.
रूढ—वंश mfn. of a high family, Daśar.
रूढ—वचन n. = रूढि-शब्द, MW.
रूढ—व्रण mfn. one whose wounds are healed, R.
रूढ—शाद्वल mfn. (a wood) whose grass has grown high, Hariv.
रूढ—श्मश्रु mfn. one whose beard his grown, R.
रूढ—सौहृद mfn. one whose friendship is grown or increased, firm in friendship, Vikr.
रूढ—स्कन्ध mfn. (a tree) whose stem or trunk has grown, high, lofty, R.
rise, ascent (lit. and fig.), increase, growth, development, Kāv.; Rājat.
birth, production, W.
decision, Rājat.
fame, celebrity, notoriety, Śiś.
tradition, custom, general prevalence, current usage (esp. of speech), Nyāyam.; Rājat.
(in rhet.) the more amplified or popular or conventional meaning of words, the employment of a word in such a meaning (as opp. to योग, q.v.), Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 2, 55; Sāh.; Kpr. &c.
रूढि—शब्द m. a word used in its conventional sense (as opp. to योग-श्˚; thus शत्रु as a Rūḍhi-śabda means ‘enemy’, but as a Yogaśabda‘destroyer’), APrāt.; Bhar. &c.
रूढि—शब्द—ता f. the state of being used in a conventional sense, Rājat.
